design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (loyalty_points_and_rewards)

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 4]}. loyalty_ext_missing_points_adjustment takes 5 factors, loyalty_ext_tier_upgrade 4, root loyalty_ext_birthday_make_good 4.

2. Why a good test. A Member-tier customer whose birthday month is ending asks why no birthday points came. Member carries 0 birthday points, so the answer "you are not eligible" is the trap. The birthday rule waits on the tier the spend has reached ("The birthday bonus is not posted until the membership carries the tier its tier-qualifying spend has reached under the tier rules."); the tier rule waits on every dispatched order in the missing-points window carrying its earning entry ("The tier the membership takes is worked out only after every dispatched order placed under the member's profile within the missing-points request window carries its earning entry on the points ledger."). The July Launch Pre-Order sneaker order never earned. The agent must post a five-factor missing-points adjustment, then work out a four-factor tier (window by membership age, store-credit reversal relief, deposit credit, Unlimited status credit) that lands on Silver, then hand the member a four-factor birthday claim. Depth 3, breadth across orders, reservations, returns and the Unlimited plan.

3. Scope snapshot. Occupied by task 0: loyalty_ext_returned_merchandise_reversal, loyalty_ext_delivery_failure_goodwill; tools post_points_reversal_46de2c04, accept_goodwill_points_7ea0a08d. Claimed here: loyalty_ext_missing_points_adjustment, loyalty_ext_tier_upgrade, loyalty_ext_birthday_make_good; tools post_missing_points_b5bbe1fa (agent), write_tier_upgrade_189dabab (agent), claim_birthday_bonus_8dc2d134 (user). Nothing remains unclaimed; all five extended policies are covered and the scopes are disjoint.

4. Base-defect route-arounds (recorded; base untouched). (a) Every base eligibility of loyalty_evt_goodwill_points is attached to the whole loyalty_bonus_posted subject, so a birthday posting would need a delivery claim as its reference; and once_per_reference binds a reference value ("2026") no record can carry. The birthday policy declares overwrite entries that restate those sentences for the birthday make-good (no claim, the year as reference, once per year). (b) The user write: the blueprint names only closure confirmation, which carries no factorable figure; the birthday make-good is claimed by the member in person (confirming the date of birth on the profile — a usual control on birthday benefits), which is not contradicted by base (base gives the scheduled day-1 posting only). (c) DSL has no calendar window; the current calendar year (tier window for long-standing members) is computed with within_months = current month number, exact on the last day of a 31-day month (2026-08-31 here); the birthday shopping window is now stated as the month ending on the claim date, which the compute implements exactly. (d) The tier rule needs every tier's tier_qualifying_spend_usd; P() reads only the tier held, so the five thresholds are mirrored as params of the tier policy with identical values. (e) The missing-points adjustment is scoped (round 2) to reservation fulfilment orders, whose object is the fulfilment order of the member's fulfilled reservation; any other unearned order stays under the base missing-points rule.

5. Factor card (handling-time world).
Missing points (expected 342; all-baseline 168): unlimited_earning_accelerator 0.10 (monthly plan active; baseline -> 323); reservation_fulfilment_accelerator 0.50 (Launch Pre-Order; -> 252); basket_accelerator 0.20 (168.00 >= 150.00 and 3 earning entries in the 6 months; -> 305); low_return_accelerator 0.05 (refund 2026-02-27 inside 12 months, none inside 6; -> 332; near-miss: that refund lies just before the 6-month window, which starts after 2026-02-28 — counting it drops the accelerator to none); late_credit (method: 45+ days -> 10 percent of the rounded points with a 25-point floor; 14-44 days -> flat 15; else none) gives 31 on 311 rounded points (baseline -> 311).
Tier upgrade (expected Silver; all-baseline Member): membership_age_spend_window (23 months -> trailing 12 months; calendar 2026 would give 247.00 qualifying, 22.00 reversed -> 279.35 -> Member); store_credit_reversal_relief (the only refund in 12 months went to a new Return Store Credit -> 0% deducted; full deduction -> 335.00 -> Member; near-miss: the 2025-07-28 card refund is 13 months back — counting it makes the refunds 'some but not all' store credit and gives 346.55 -> Member); deposit_status_credit (the member's Deposit Pre-Order reserved -> half its 40.00 deposit; none -> 338.10 -> Member); unlimited_status_credit (5%; none -> 342.00 -> Member). Tier spend 358.10 vs Silver 350.00 / Gold 750.00.
Birthday (expected 467; all-baseline 250): birthday_shopping_boost (method: 150.00+ -> tier amount doubled; above 0 -> the month's merchandise credited again at the tier multiplier and added; none -> tier amount stands) adds 17 for 13.60 booked within the month ending 2026-08-31 (-> 450; near-miss: the 168.00 sneaker line of 2026-07-10 lies outside the month and would double the amount); birthday_tenure_gift 50 (23 months; -> 417); birthday_unlimited_gift 50 (monthly; -> 417); birthday_items_bought_gift 100 (9 lines in 12 months; -> 367).
Multi-source: basket_accelerator (order spend AND ledger count). The Unlimited factors read plan and status from one row and are not counted as multi-source. Cross-difficulty: reservation_fulfilment_accelerator and deposit_status_credit (preorders), low_return_accelerator and store_credit_reversal_relief (returns).

6. Base-invariant card. Missing points: membership_open (active); request_window (placed 2026-07-10, day 52 of 90, inclusive); settle_after_dispatch (dispatched 2026-07-14, day 48 >= 3); order_dispatched (delivered); purchaser_is_member (order customer = member); not_already_earned (no earning row with that order_id). Tier: membership_active. Birthday: membership_active; birthday_tenure (enrolled 2024-09-05, inclusive 30 days); once_per_reference and the goodwill gates restated by the birthday overwrite (no 2026 birthday row exists).

7. Business-object card. Target: the sneaker order (fulfilment order of the Launch Pre-Order; one 168.00 footwear line, card). Included in window spend: earning entries of the 12 months ending 2026-08-31 (154.00 + 168.00) and the 22.00 reversal of the Store Credit Return. Excluded: 2025-07-19 and 2024-11-20 earnings (outside), the Deposit Pre-Order (not an order; only its deposit credit). Birthday reference: year 2026, no existing row.

8. Seed rationale and automatic clauses. Balance 712 = ledger sum; available points 698 < 2,000 (no conversion due); last earning 2026-08-27 (no inactivity); the reversals for both refunded returns are on the ledger (no reversal owed); Member at opening is the tier the recorded spend gives (no upgrade due until the missing earning lands); no approved delivery claim (no goodwill question). Denver tax 8.81% on every order; Unlimited Standard Monthly gives free Standard Ground.

9. Problem-tree card. Edges: birthday -> tier (value_input, gate tier_amount, state form, negated direction "is not posted until"); tier -> missing points (value_input, gate window_qual, state form, affirmative "only after"). Exactly one write of the difficulty sets a membership's tier (the tier upgrade); exactly one books an earning entry for a dispatched order (the missing-points adjustment). Unmet at opening: variant_name Member while the rules reach Silver; no earning row for the sneaker order. Resolution order: missing points, tier upgrade, birthday claim. Deletion sensitivity: skip the upgrade -> birthday 0; skip the missing earning -> tier stays Member (181.70). The customer never mentions orders, tiers or anything to do first.

10. Persona. Fast-talking, friendly UX designer; volunteers only the birthday request; credentials on request; passive reactions to the missing earning (remembers the launch sneakers), to the tier update and to the hand-over of the claim; ends on the claim confirmation (last gold action).

11. Standard solution and verification. Locate -> verify -> membership -> ledger -> orders -> order lines -> payments -> reservations -> reservation entries -> returns -> return lines -> settlements -> Unlimited plan -> post missing points 342 -> write Silver valid through 2027-12-31 -> hand over the birthday claim of 467 for 2026. Gates run per task (check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cache_diff, check_cross_fire); check_compute recomputes 342, Silver and 467 at handling time and every baseline figure above.


12. Revision log (round 2, policy-task audit). G7/T1-F1: late_credit_factor was a rate in one formula -> replaced by late_credit, whose tiers compute the credit differently (percentage of the rounded points with a 25-point floor, a flat 15 points, none); points unchanged at handling time, sensitivities re-run. G8/T1-F2: birthday_month_shopping_factor was a rate -> replaced by birthday_shopping_boost (double the tier amount / credit the month's merchandise again at the tier multiplier and add it / tier amount stands); expected re-run to 467. G5: the shopping window is now 'within the month ending on the claim date (an order dated on the same day of the previous month not counting)', exactly the compute's window. G4: the missing-points adjustment now governs reservation fulfilment orders and names its object as the fulfilment order of the member's fulfilled reservation; the reservation ladder's fall-through is the back-order types. G6: the deposit credit reads only the reservation_events of the member's Deposit Pre-Order. G2: the late-written upgrade's start (date written) and validity (31 December of the year after the year the spend reached the threshold) are declared in overwrite against the base sentence. O5: the birthday edge condition now names the tier the upgrade rule yields once its own prerequisite holds. T1-O1: near-misses that flip tiers were planted — the Store Credit Return refund moved to 2026-02-27 (just outside the 6-month window, return on the February order whose lines were split accordingly), and a 2025-07-28 card-refunded return on the July 2025 order (outside the 12-month window; counting it halves the store-credit relief). T1-O2: the Unlimited factors are no longer called multi-source. All gates re-run green.
user_scenario: You are Nadia Chowdhury, a thirty-two-year-old UX designer in Denver who talks fast, laughs easily and tends to apologise for rambling. Your birthday was on the seventeenth of this month, and this year no Marlowe Rewards birthday points showed up on your account, even though a friend of yours got hers right on the first of her birth month. You are calling to get the birthday points you think you should have for this year, today, while it is still your birthday month. That is all you bring up at the start; you do not mention any orders or tiers. Only when the agent asks: your name is Nadia Chowdhury, your sign-in email is nadia.chowdhury@outlook.com and your mobile is 7205550104; if a further detail is needed your date of birth is 1994-08-17 and your billing ZIP is 80206. You do not know your membership number, your points balance or which tier you are in, and you say so if asked. If the agent tells you that one of your orders never earned its points, you remember the white Court Runner sneakers you pre-ordered for the launch and that arrived in July, say you had no idea, and agree to have it fixed. If the agent says your tier needs updating first, you say that sounds great and to go ahead. If the agent asks whether they may make changes on your rewards account, you say yes. When the agent explains that the birthday bonus has to be claimed by you personally and hands you the step, you claim it right away with exactly the details the agent reads out, happy to confirm that your birthday is 1994-08-17 if asked. You never suggest a number of points. Once you see the confirmation that the birthday points are on your account, you thank the agent warmly and hang up.

base_preconditions.condition: Points post only while the membership is in status active or suspended.

base_preconditions.condition: Birthday, review, referral and goodwill bonuses post only while the membership is in status active (`suspension_withholds_rewards`); the welcome bonus posts with the enrollment itself.
A birthday bonus posts only if the membership is enrolled at least `birthday_bonus_min_tenure_days` calendar days before the bonus posting date.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.points: 342. qualifying spend 168.00 (one footwear line, no gift cards, no Rewards Note capture, nothing credited on returns); multiplier = Member 1.00 + unlimited_earning_accelerator 0.10 (Unlimited Standard Monthly, active) + reservation_fulfilment_accelerator 0.50 (Launch Pre-Order) + basket_accelerator 0.20 (spend >= 150.00 and 3 earning entries in the 6 months ending 2026-08-31) + low_return_accelerator 0.05 (refund 2026-02-27 inside 12 months, none inside 6) = 1.85; rounded points int(168.00 x 1 x 1.85 + 0.5) = 311; late_credit: 48 days since dispatch 2026-07-14 -> 10 percent of 311 rounded = 31 (>= 25); 311 + 31 = 342.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: 60647669-aa78-4c7e-a226-0c3e40b633d9; basis: membership lookup; uniqueness: one membership.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.order_id: 20f92fdd-26b6-4e6b-b83e-58d90904d081; basis: rule 'The order concerned is the order recorded as the fulfilment order of the member's reservation in status fulfilled.' — the Launch Pre-Order's fulfilment order; it is also the only dispatched order without an earning entry; uniqueness: every other dispatched order has its earning entry.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.qualifying_spend_usd: 168.0; basis: rule 'The entry records the qualifying spend' — the qualifying-spend intermediate of the same computation (line 168.00, no deductions); uniqueness: one line on the order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.tier_multiplier_applied: 1.0; basis: rule 'The entry records ... the tier held on the handling date and that tier's tier_points_multiplier' — Member's tier_points_multiplier 1.00; uniqueness: the tier held today.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.available_date: 2026-08-31; basis: rule 'is available on the later of the handling date and the dispatch date plus points_pending_days calendar days' — 2026-07-14 + 30 = 2026-08-13, earlier than the handling date 2026-08-31; uniqueness: the later of two fixed dates.

edges.condition: loyalty_memberships.variant_name equals the tier the tier-upgrade rule yields when that rule is worked out on a ledger that already carries every earning entry its own prerequisite requires.
edges.policy_source: The birthday bonus is not posted until the membership carries the tier its tier-qualifying spend has reached under the tier rules.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The membership shows Marlowe Rewards Member, but under the tier rules (which first need the sneaker order's earning entry) the tier-qualifying spend reaches Silver; the record lags the tier reached.

edges.condition: Every order in status shipped, delivered or closed placed under the member's customer_id within missing_points_request_window_days of the handling date has a loyalty_points_earned row with its order_id.
edges.policy_source: The tier the membership takes is worked out only after every dispatched order placed under the member's profile within the missing-points request window carries its earning entry on the points ledger.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain: the upgrade reads the window spend the missing earning adds, and the birthday reads the tier the upgrade writes; any other order leaves the tier at Member (birthday 0) or skips Silver, so only missing points -> upgrade -> birthday reproduces gold. No two writes are parallel.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the upgrade the tier held is Member, birthday_bonus_points 0, so birthday_points = 0 (nothing to claim) instead of 467; terminal variant_name stays Member.
Without the missing earning the 12-month window qualifying spend is 154.00 -> tier spend 181.70 -> Marlowe Rewards Member instead of Silver; no earning row for the sneaker order.
